# vec{F}-index of the knots with at most 10 crossings

All tree diagrams of vec{F} with n <= 17 leaves (knots only occur for odd n: results/parity_theorem.md): 200 of the 250 knots have a known vec{F}-index; for the others "≥" is a lower bound (no diagram with fewer leaves has their HOMFLY polynomial; at n = 19 only the HOMFLY classes were enumerated: results/Fvec_n19_classes.csv). Indices 19 and 21 beyond the enumeration come from certified witnesses (results/Fvec_beyond17_certified.md). Knots up to mirror image (and, for invertible knots, the orientation does not matter: L(g^-1) is the mirror image of the reverse of L(g)). For the non-invertible knots the index of K (orientation of KnotInfo) and of its reverse Kr is given. F-index and F₃-index and F⃗₃-index (oriented subgroup of F₃) for comparison. The representative is an element of vec{F} realizing the index.
